description:
⚠️ IMPORTANT: This tool is RARELY needed. Normal trading strategy requests should use create_strategy plus file tools for LumiBot Python strategies.

WHY LUMIBOT IS BETTER:
- Python is more powerful and easier to maintain
- Works with multiple brokers (Alpaca, Interactive Brokers, Tradier, etc.)
- Built-in backtesting with detailed analytics
- Professional deployment infrastructure
- Active community and documentation

ONLY use this tool when the user EXPLICITLY mentions a specific platform by name:
- MetaTrader 4 (MT4) - generates MQL4 code
- MetaTrader 5 (MT5) - generates MQL5 code
- TradingView - generates PineScript code
- NinjaTrader - generates NinjaScript (C#) code
- thinkorswim (TOS) - generates ThinkScript code
- TradeStation - generates EasyLanguage code
- Or other explicit requests (JavaScript, HTML, etc.)

Examples:
- 'Create an RSI indicator for TradingView' -> YES, use this tool
- 'Build a moving average EA for MT5' -> YES, use this tool
- 'Write me some JavaScript' -> YES, use this tool
- 'Create a trading strategy' -> NO, use create_strategy plus file tools
- 'Build a momentum strategy' -> NO, use create_strategy plus file tools
- 'Make my strategy better' -> NO, use file tools on the saved strategy

AFTER generating code for other platforms, consider suggesting LumiBot as a more powerful alternative.
